about: Hand-reviewed exclusions applied by scripts/build-store-snapshot.mjs to the SNAP Supermarket + Super Store pull (docs/07 'Stores'). Rules are tested against the named field in file order; a record is attributed to the FIRST rule it matches, so per-rule counts in public/data/stores/manifest.json add up. Reviewed 2026-10-02 against every matched name (data last edited 2026-09-17).

rules.reason: Warehouse club (paid membership): Costco Wholesale warehouses, Costco Business Centers and one in-warehouse 'Costco Pharmacy' listing.
Warehouse club (paid membership): Sam's Club. Requires 'CLUB' so 'Sam's Foods Supermarket' (Atwater CA) is not matched.

Warehouse club (paid membership): BJ's Wholesale Club, incl. the 'B JS WHOLESALE CLUB', 'BJS WHOLESALE CLUB' and 'BJ'S MEMBERSHIP CLUB' spellings, plus the number-only listing 'BJs 351' (6607 Wilson Blvd, Falls Church VA: judgment call, the BJ's club at Seven Corners). A bare 'BJ'S' is deliberately not matched because it also names non-club stores.
Military commissary (DeCA): sells only to authorized patrons (service members, retirees, dependents). Every match on 2026-10-02 is a DeCA store with a store number on or beside an installation.

DeCA commissaries listed under the installation name without the word 'commissary': 'Charleston AFB SC 308', 'Kirtland AFB 821', 'McGuire Air force Base 2323', 'Picatinney Arsenal 2104', 'NASJRB Ft Worth 630', 'DECA KINGSVILLE 620'.
Navy Exchange (NEX): on-installation retail for authorized patrons only. Matches 'Navy Exchange' itself, never a bare 'Exchange' (e.g. '185 Exchange Street Food Corp/Key Food', Chicopee MA, is kept).
Judgment call: the mini mart at U.S. Naval Hospital Guam (Farenholt Ave & Hessler St). The name lacks 'exchange' but the store is inside the installation, which only authorized patrons can enter.

Marine Corps Exchange (MCX): on-installation retail for authorized patrons only. Matches nothing on 2026-10-02; kept so a refresh can't let one in silently. Only the store name is tested, so Guam stores on 'Marine Corps Dr' are unaffected.
Army & Air Force Exchange Service (AAFES, PX/BX) and Coast Guard Exchange (CGX): on-installation retail for authorized patrons only. Matches nothing on 2026-10-02; kept for refreshes.

Supermarket-branded fuel station, not a grocery store: 'Safeway Fuel Station', 'Von's Fuel Station', 'Vons Fuel Center', 'Albertsons Fuel', 'Martin's Super Market Fuel Center', 'Bens Supercenter Fuelcenter BC', and (judgment call) 'Food City Gas N Go Express', Food City's fuel-and-convenience format.
